DA.data_type: Subreddit posts and comments related to climate change. They used a publicly available copy of Reddit downloaded from the Google Big Query data warehouse2, spanning from January 2016 to August 2019 inclusive. They filtered for specific climate related keywords. “we identified subreddits whose posts and comments contain the most substring matches of the 11 climate terms. Among them we found five subreddits, which we call climate subreddits, whose names and accompanying descriptions suggest that they focus on climate change and its impacts: r/climate, r/environment, r/climatechange, r/climateskeptics, and r/climateOffensive.”
